headline: DMP: Tight security planned across Dhaka for Durga Puja
summary: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police will implement comprehensive security measures to ensure a safe celebration of the upcoming festival.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has announced plans for tight security across the capital city to ensure the safety of worshippers during Durga Puja.
The security measures will beinclude comprehensive monitoring and increased police presence at puja mandaps and key locations across Dhaka.
The DMP aims to prevent any untoward incidents and maintain peace and harmony during the festival celebrations.
Police officials stated that the security plan includes coordination with committee members of the puja mandaps to ensure a safe environment for devotees.
caption:
Dhaka is gearing up for Durga Puja with a massive security operation.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has announced plans for tight security across the capital city to ensure the safety of worshippers during Durga Puja.

The security measures will beinclude comprehensive monitoring and increased police presence at puja mandaps and key locations across Dhaka.

The DMP aims to prevent any untoward incidents and maintain peace and harmony during the festival celebrations.

Police officials stated that the security plan includes coordination with committee members of the puja mandaps to ensure a safe environment for devotees.
